messages:
Alex: Heads up — NovaBank SRE pinged. They want p95 <= 120ms for chat endpoint but also pushing for p99 <= 300ms. Sales says they'll pay for dedicated if we can hit both. Thinking microbatch=1 for low tail but throughput suffers. Thoughts?

Maria: They offered 3yr commitment if we can support p99 300ms at their peak qps. They're worried about 'long tail' on large contexts. @Sam maybe product needs to sign off on carveouts.

Sam: We should confirm whether p99 is strict for all routes or just interactive chat. Also ok with carving out heavy requests >2k tokens? That reduces tail risk.

Nina: Quick profiling: ran nightly job on model-redwood-3b w/ sim qps 400, seq_len dist from NovaBank. Key findings: KV cache warmup accounts for ~45% of p99 spikes; kernel switch (float16->int8 path) adds 30-80ms on 2% of requests when we fall back. Microbatch=1 removes batching queuing variance but reduces throughput by ~28%.

Nina: ```text
profile@2026-03-15
p95 110ms
p99 420ms
top causes: kv_cold (45%), kernel_swap (2% @ +80ms), microburst_gc (1%)
```

Ryan: We can mitigate kv_cold by prewarming prefixes and sticky routing. Suggest TTL-based KV keepalive + prefix-cache with LRU for top-50 prefixes. Also can route large requests to dedicated pool.

Alex: If we agree to dedicated for NovaBank, we can tune kernel selection to avoid swap: pin quantized kernel on their pool, disable dynamic kernel swap on p99 path. Tradeoff: slightly higher memory usage and lower overall model density.

Sam: Product ask: can we commit to p95 120ms and p99 300ms for the chat route only, with condition: 'requests > 2k tokens or embeddings/rerank' excluded? Also need fallback plan if QPS spikes.

Maria: Customer accepts carveout. But they want a canary run next Wed. Sales wants a one-pager on risk factors.

Nina: Plan & experiments I'll run: (1) prewarm top-100 prefixes, (2) pin int8 kernel on their pool, (3) microbatch=2 with adaptive window to reduce queuing jitter. Expected: p95 ~105ms, p99 ~280ms in sims. If kv cold still dominates, we'll add aggressive keepalive.

Nina: Config I'll try next:
```json
{
  "microbatch": {"min":1,"max":4,"latency_target_ms":120,"adaptation_interval_s":15},
  "kv": {"keepalive": true,"top_prefixes":100}
}
```

CanaryBot: canary deployed to nova-pool v2.1 — health ok :white_check_mark:

Ryan: SRE checklist for canary: 1) trace sampling p99 100% for 30m, 2) A/B compare tokens/cost, 3) fallbacks configured — route to hosted if tail > threshold

Alex: Action items: Nina run sim and post numbers by Tue EOD; Ryan prepare canary infra; Sam docs carveout; Maria coordinate with customer for Wed canary. +@Nina please add regression alert for kernel_swap.

Nina: Got it. I'll add alert "kernel_swap_rate > 0.5% -> page oncall".

Maria: Copied — I'll email customer the canary window.

Alex: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the sim.
